title: conv.cc2amp
description: `conv.cc2amp` converts a MIDI Control Change value in the 0–127 range to a configurable output range, defaulting to 0–1. Set the output range with the `FROM` and `TO` arguments or the `@from` and `@to` properties; for example, `conv.cc2amp @from 1 @to -1` maps into a descending range.
